sentences.en: A van came to the house.
sentences.zh: 一个送货车来到这房子。

sentences.en: "What a big van!" said Chip.
sentences.zh: 什么一个大的送货车！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "What a big man!" said Kipper.
sentences.zh: 什么一个大的男人！ 说 Kipper。

sentences.en: The man looked at the things.
sentences.zh: 这男人看在这东西。

sentences.en: "What a lot of things!" he said.
sentences.zh: 什么一个许多的东西！ 他说。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad helped the man.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸帮助这男人。

sentences.en: They put things in the van.
sentences.zh: 他们放东西在……里这送货车。

sentences.en: "What a job!" said Dad.
sentences.zh: 什么一个工作！ 说爸爸。

sentences.en: The children helped too.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们帮助也。

sentences.en: Kipper put his toys in the van.
sentences.zh: Kipper 放他的玩具在……里这送货车。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip put the go-kart in.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 放这卡丁车在……里。

sentences.en: They put a box in the van.
sentences.zh: 他们放一个盒子在……里这送货车。

sentences.en: "What a big box!" said Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么一个大的盒子！ 说 Biff。

sentences.en: What a job!" said everyone.
sentences.zh: 什么一个工作！ 说每个人。

sentences.en: "Goodbye," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 再见， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "Goodbye," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 再见， 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Come and play soon," they said.
sentences.zh: 来和玩很快， 他们说。

sentences.en: The van went to the new house.
sentences.zh: 这送货车去到这新的房子。

sentences.en: Dad looked at Biff and Chip "Oh no!"
sentences.zh: 爸爸看在 Biff 和 Chip 哦不！

sentences.en: Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: "What a job!" they said.
sentences.zh: 什么一个工作！ 他们说。

sentences.en: When I moved house I packed...
sentences.zh: 当……时我移动房子我拥挤的。。。

sentences.en: To help the child to concentrate and remember what has been said.
sentences.zh: 到帮助这孩子到全神贯注和记得什么有是说。

sentences.en: • Think of something you would pack if you moved house.
sentences.zh: • 想的某物你会盒如果你移动房子。

sentences.en: When I moved house I packed my clothes."
sentences.zh: 当……时我移动房子我拥挤的我的衣服。

sentences.en: • The child thinks of something else, and says, e.
sentences.zh: • 这孩子想的某物其他， 和说， 呃。

sentences.en: "When I moved house I packed my clothes and my teddy."
sentences.zh: 当……时我移动房子我拥挤的我的衣服和我的泰迪熊。

sentences.en: • Go on taking turns, adding another thing each time.
sentences.zh: • 去在……上拿转动， 补充另一个东西每个时间。

sentences.en: • Have fun going on until you begin to forget what came next.
sentences.zh: • 有乐趣去在……上直到你开始到忘记什么来下一个。

sentences.en: You can use these ideas straight away, or on another day.
sentences.zh: 你能使用这些主意直的离开， 或者在……上另一个一天。

sentences.en: • Ask the child to find words with three letters in the story and to say the sounds of the letters in each word, e.
sentences.zh: • 问这孩子到找到单词和……一起三信在……里这故事和到说这声音的这信在……里每个单词， 呃。

sentences.en: 'job': j-o-b.
sentences.zh: '工作'： j-o-b。

sentences.en: The child can then practise spelling them.
sentences.zh: 这孩子能然后练习拼写他们。

sentences.en: Find 'man' and 'van' in the story (pages 2 and 3).
sentences.zh: 找到 '男人' 和 '送货车' 在……里这故事 (页 2 和 3)。

sentences.en: Ask the child to think of as many words as he/she can that rhyme with 'man'.
sentences.zh: 问这孩子到想的像许多单词像他/她能那个押韵和……一起 '男人'。

sentences.en: Praise the child for thinking of lots of words.
sentences.zh: 称赞这孩子为了想的许多的单词。
